_doc: Template for a React project that wants the itshover components as real .tsx files. Copy it to the React app root as components.json, then: npx shadcn@latest add https://itshover.com/r/plug-connected-icon.json (or npx shadcn@latest add @itshover/plug-connected-icon once the registry alias resolves). Requires internet — it cannot run inside this sandbox, so the SVG + canvas + Pillow icons in this folder are the offline path.
$schema_note: shadcn CLI reads the fields below; the underscore keys are ignored.
